description:
Stop moths ruining your clothes

Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer for Wardrobes is a proven fast-acting formula developed to safely kill moths and protect your fabrics against clothes moths (Tineola Bisselliella).

Our effective BPR Certified moth-repellent hangers feature a lavender-infused, potent slow-release insecticide vapour that works on three levels:

  1. Eliminates adult moths, eggs and larvae to stop reproduction.
  2. Provides ongoing control against moth presence to prevent infestation.
  3. Keeps clothes smelling and feeling fresh.

Unlike pheromone moth traps, Ready Steady Defend hangers work by repelling rather than trapping, allowing them to be used safely in enclosed spaces. Our formula is non-staining and safe for all fabrics, making hangers a suitable moth killer for home wardrobes, drawers, cupboards and storage bags. 

Each moth-repellent hanger delivers up to three months of protection and features a date wheel to help you monitor expiration so you can easily swap for a fresh hanger to maintain protection.

One pack includes 6 hangers, giving you up to 9 months of repellency against damage-causing insects. 

How to use Ready Steady Defend Moth Killer for Wardrobes

Using our hangers couldn’t be easier. Simply remove a hanger from the outer packaging, remove the wrapper and hang or place in storage space.

Each hanger protects up to 0.25 cubic metres:

  • Use one hanger per drawer or laundry bag.
  • Use two hangers per single wardrobe.
  • Use three hangers per double wardrobe.

Product benefits

  • Long-lasting protection – each hanger kills clothes moths for up to three months. Each pack delivers up to 18 months of protection.
